topic: Modus changes and inventory management updates
summary_markdown:
The conversation focused on technical difficulties encountered when working with Modus, specifically related to making changes to asset files (e.g., renaming facilities and boxes) that were not immediately visible in the system.

*   **Modus Issue:** Changes only appeared after multiple reloads or exiting/re-entering the impersonation state.
*   **Upcoming Feature:** [me] committed to developing an inventory management feature within analytics this week. This will allow for reliable, single-item control (though import/export functionality might be added later).
*   **Action Plan:** [me] plans to refine the import/export process in Modus today and improve error diagnostics to prevent silent failures.
